scope: Focused research and revision of E-book accessibility metadata.md. No EPUB file audit, market-wide vendor assessment, 27-country compliance comparison or new sanctions/enforcement/adoption conclusions.

baseline.live_pr_overlap: Live PR #84 contains the already-merged testing page rename and introduction. This research is a separate testing draft.

budget.includes: Research, verification and source-fidelity retrieval; excludes rendering and PR preparation.

sources.section: Articles 2, 3(41)-(42), 4(3)/(5), 13(2); Annex I III/IV(f); Annex V
sources.finding: Distinguishes e-book services from dedicated e-reader products, requires feature metadata, and separately requires accessible public information about covered services. Recital 41 is not the Article 3 definition.

sources.section: Additional requirement for e-books; Additional obligations related to the accessibility statement
sources.finding: Finnish guidance identifies additional statement content for listed consumer services, including e-books. It supports a Finland example, not a cross-country compliance guarantee.

sources.section: Status; 2.2 Package metadata; 2.3 Linked metadata records; 3.5 Conformance reporting
sources.finding: Recommendation. Requires accessMode, accessibilityFeature and accessibilityHazard; recommends accessModeSufficient and accessibilitySummary. Linked metadata alone is insufficient. Conformance reporting identifies an evaluator, which may be the publisher.
Candidate Recommendation Draft dated 12 September 2026; accessModeSufficient required and accessMode recommended in this draft. Not silently substituted for the published 1.1 Recommendation.
Community guidance supports capability-oriented display/filtering, neutral treatment of absent metadata, attribution of publisher declarations, and refreshed displays when metadata changes.
ONIX supplies book information to sales, lending and subscription platforms, including before publication; it complements embedded metadata and can generate reader-facing descriptions.

Official list currently labels itself Issue 75. Use the list title rather than preserve the stale Issue 69 label. Unknown and inaccessible/limited are distinct; a summary complements structured detail.

sources.section: Title, status, introduction, property guidance and Appendix A examples
sources.finding: Published Community Group guide provides EPUB package metadata syntax and examples; replaces the old moved example URL.
Mappings between EPUB/schema.org, ONIX and other vocabularies are not always reversible; formats can preserve different detail.
EPUBCheck checks EPUB structure, Ace automates some accessibility checks, and manual evaluation remains necessary.
Dated announcement reports storefront accessibility information and filtering. Does not support the inherited future expansion promise or independently verify a particular book.
English vocabulary reference retained; not treated as an ebook format or legal compliance certificate.
Published English vocabulary reference retained with a page-level link rather than an unrelated property fragment.

changes.existing: Recital (41) presented as the definition; long text fragments anchored to Annex VI.
changes.action: Use Article 3 definition and source sections; concise Annex I summary.

changes.existing: Following Finland can be assumed to cover all countries; Finland alone is clear and strict.
changes.action: Omit the unsupported comparative guarantee. Keep Finland as a scoped national example.

changes.existing: A metadata table should be enough; an ONIX-based statement does not make sense.
changes.action: Separate service information from publication metadata; explain the role of ONIX in supply and display.

changes.existing: Unqualified requirements for embedded data, search filters and visual display.
changes.action: Attribute EPUB package rules to EPUB 1.1 and display/filter recommendations to the Community Group guide.

changes.existing: ONIX Issue 69 label; EPUB described as metadata to send to publishers; moved examples.
changes.action: Correct source roles, use EDItEUR list title and published authoring guide; retain schema.org and vocabulary references.

changes.existing: No version distinction or validation guidance.
changes.action: Add 1.1 metadata table, clearly labelled 1.2 draft change, crosswalk and automated/manual validation guidance.

changes.existing: Accessible-book endorsement and Kobo future filter expansion promise.
changes.action: Retain contributor listing as retailer reference; replace unsupported current/future claim with dated primary announcement.

follow_up: If a verified accessible-book example is wanted, obtain and evaluate the exact edition and inspect its current storefront metadata; a retailer announcement alone is insufficient.
Revisit EPUB Accessibility 1.2 when its publication status changes; this draft is explicitly dated.
Any country comparison requires a separately scoped check of national implementation and service circumstances.
